sect2.title: Installation of xdg-desktop-portal-wlr
sect2.para: Install xdg-desktop-portal-wlr by running the following commands:

screen.userinput:
mkdir build && cd build &&
meson setup --prefix=/usr \ --buildtype=release \ .. && ninja

sect2.para: This package doesn't come with a test suite.
Ensure the portal can be detected as the &root; user:

note.para: If xdg-desktop-portal-wlr is installed and Xfce is run under X11, the xfce-portals.conf file in /usr/share/xdg-desktop-portal tells xdg-desktop-portal to try the wlr backend first for screen casting. The wlr backend's user service is skipped when WAYLAND_DISPLAY is not set, but the portal is not told about it and waits 25 seconds for a D-Bus timeout every time it starts. Applications that query the portal stall for the same amount of time. To avoid this, override the setting for your user:
This disables the screen cast portal in all Xfce sessions for that user, including Wayland sessions. Do not make this change if you run Xfce under Wayland.
